production.direction_en: Five heroes enter a circular chamber beneath a suspended black sun. A crownless, clockwork guardian unfolds from the altar. During the battle, the VN camera returns briefly between phases to show Fadyme hiding the ash-dark veins spreading past her wrist.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch7_altar (chaotic layer) | battle: bgm_boss_eclipse_construct (phase 1, phase 2 adds choir and the bell motif) | post: silence after 'HOUR... STILL OWED.'

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Five of us. We have broken worse lines than this.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: And if the altar asks for a name?

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: No. We leave with all five names. That is the only answer I will accept.
